spec_match.rationale: Uses ::interest-button exactly as the spec motivates: touch affordance for links whose long-press opens a context menu.

interactive.rationale: Real article links with hovercards; ⓘ tap shows interest, link tap navigates to an in-page reference; force-show toggle; live interest/loseinterest/toggle/hashchange log.

blurb_alignment.rationale: Composition (popover=hint, implicit anchor, interest-delay, :interest-source) and the navigate-vs-preview distinction are delivered.

edge_cases.rationale: Detects clicks on the pseudo box via text-range geometry and asserts no navigation + interest; reports partial rendering as unexpected instead of hiding it; no-flag state labelled.

references.rationale: ChromeStatus, explainer and the parent interestfor demo.

conformance.rationale: Exercises the manual activation-shows-interest-not-navigation assertion end to end.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Headless Chromium 153.0.8010.12 (Playwright) at 1280x800 and 360x740 DPR3 touch, both without the flag and with --enable-blink-features=HTMLInterestForInterestButtonPseudo; console and network clean, 0px horizontal overflow on every run. Flag on desktop (force-show): 4/4 boxes, click on ⓘ → interest c-tbl, card open adjacent below the link, no navigation; click on text → navigated to #ref-berners-lee. Flag on mobile: 4/4 boxes by default, touch tap on ⓘ → interest and card open, no navigation. No flag: 0 boxes, honest fallback text. Fixed an earlier 1-of-4 miscount caused by wrapped links; mobile screenshot reviewed for card adjacency.

telemetry_health.rationale: Asserts tap→interest without navigation, all-links rendering when wanted, and a fallback assert that the status never claims rendering when no box exists.

accessibility.rationale: Links carry aria-describedby to role=tooltip cards per guidance; ⓘ decorative. Screen reader output not verified with a real AT or DevTools AX tree.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: Mobile: native ⓘ by default; desktop: hover/focus plus optional force-show; card max width reduced to keep it inside 360px.

openQuestions.title: Verify description exposure with a screen reader
openQuestions.detail: Check that the role=tooltip cards are read as descriptions of the links and that the ⓘ adds nothing to the AX tree.

guidanceConsulted.query: popover anchored to invoker hint tooltip
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Hovercards: interestfor + popover=hint, interest-delay tuning, :root:has(:interest-source) zero start delay, @starting-style entry gated on prefers-reduced-motion.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Applied verbatim in the article: interest-delay 0.4s 0.2s, zero start delay once a card is open, opacity transition only under no-preference.

guidanceConsulted.query: touch-friendly info button next to link hover card interestfor
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Hints use popover="hint"; link triggers get role=tooltip + aria-describedby (never aria-expanded); position via the implicit anchor with position-area + flip fallbacks gated in @supports so unsupported browsers keep UA centring.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: All hint popovers are popover=hint, role=tooltip; anchor rules are inside @supports (position-area: block-end).

guidanceConsulted.query: accessible CSS generated content alt text decorative glyph
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Use content: "x" / "" for purely decorative generated text; never carry meaning only in generated content.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Every ::interest-button rule uses content: "ⓘ" / ""; the meaning stays on the link and its hint.

guidanceConsulted.query: responsive control panel without horizontal overflow
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Grids collapse to one column on narrow viewports, long tokens wrap, tap targets >= 44px.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Single-column grids below 720px, overflow-wrap:anywhere on code/readouts, 44px labels/buttons; measured 0px overflow at 360px.

summary: Practical article with touch-friendly hovercards composing interest invokers, hint popovers, anchor positioning and ::interest-button.
